column1: # Whose deviation is each unresolved Android import (tools/gen-android-gaps.py,
# status 4.749).  Configuration: android-arm64.  `c-included` = C compiles a
# reference, so C's own library imports it too (an upstream gap); `c-excluded` =
# every C reference is under a condition this configuration answers false, so the
# port compiled what C leaves out (a defect in the port unit that imports it);
# `no-reference` = no file in the build set even calls it (an invented import).
